title: Coin sync
tagline: A Telegram bot that simplifies crypto portfolio management. Link all your wallets in one place, get real-time balance updates, gas fee alerts, and make micro-transactions. Manage your crypto smarter and faster with secure, seamless wallet integration—all within Telegram!
description:
This project is a Telegram-based bot that simplifies cryptocurrency portfolio management by utilizing a dynamic embedded wallet, allowing users to link multiple wallets from various blockchains into one unified view. With real-time updates, seamless transactions, and an intuitive interface, the bot efficiently manages crypto portfolios directly within Telegram.

Key Features:
- Link All Wallets in One Place: Users can connect wallets from multiple blockchain networks to monitor all assets under one interface.
- Real-Time Portfolio Updates: The bot provides dynamic updates on portfolio balances, ensuring users are always aware of the current value of their holdings.
- Gas Fee Optimization Alerts: Users receive real-time notifications when gas fees drop, enabling them to time transactions for the lowest cost, making their crypto activity more efficient.
- Seamless Transactions: The bot allows fast and secure peer-to-peer crypto payments within Telegram, powered by the embedded wallet, ideal for tipping, micro-payments, and rapid transfers.
- Portfolio Performance Monitoring: Users get insights and alerts on portfolio movements, such as significant gains, losses, or price trends, helping them make informed decisions.

User Experience:
- With a user-friendly interface designed for both new and experienced crypto enthusiasts, the bot simplifies crypto portfolio management:
- Easily link and track multiple wallets in one view.
- Get daily, weekly, or on-demand portfolio summaries.
- Make secure micro-transactions and receive real-time market insights.
how_its_made:
- The bot integrates Dynamic embedded wallet that can adjust to multiple blockchain ecosystems, allowing easy interactions across diverse crypto assets. Users can link their wallets and perform all crypto-related operations within the bot, without needing external apps or extensions.
- Real-Time Notifications: The bot sends real-time alerts using Telegram’s API, keeping users updated on gas fees, portfolio changes, and security warnings.
- Integrated Transactions: Through the embedded wallet, users can conduct transfers, swaps, or staking directly from the Telegram interface.
